notes.title: OFF 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Boss #3 and #5 re-balanced, more text, more animation.
[*] If a Competence or enemy skill has a random element, the picked random element will be shown.
[*] Fixed rare occurrence of incorrect sprite during Enoch fight.
[*] Fixed very rare issue near the end of the game where combat may cause an abrupt game over.
[*] Other enemy and boss balance updates, text inaccuracies, and fixes.
[/list]
